Name: Pig Pam
Author: SuperPiggeh778
Description:
I made a masterpiece lol

Version 1.1 Changes: Small dialouge update. (the pig still speaks english so don't expect oink oink oink)

Incompatable with any SMAPI/Content Patcher mods that change Pam's portrait, sprite, or dialouge

If you have any bug reports/suggestions please let me know :D

Anyways instructions in case you've never installed a XNB mod before...

1. EITHER BACKUP ORIGINAL FILES OR [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2275]INSTALL XNB LOADER[/url]
2. Open the downloaded zip file, copy each "Pam.xnb" (one by one) and either put them in their respective game folders, or inside XnbLoader's ModContent folders. 
3. Load up the game, stand outside Pam's trailer (house, if you're a cool kid) until she either comes out or unlocks the front door, and HAIL TO YOUR NEW GOD THE PIG PAM
